mainEntity.name: What makes KenVision different from traditional video surveillance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unlike passive CCTV recording, KenVision actively analyzes live video to detect threats, flag anomalies, and trigger alerts in real time. It eliminates the need for manual footage review and integrates with existing camera hardware across any vendor.

mainEntity.name: Is KenVision compatible with all camera brands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. KenVision is device-agnostic and works with cameras from all major manufacturers. It connects via standard RTSP streams or SDK integrations, making it compatible with virtually any existing surveillance setup.

video-surveillance.h1: AI video surveillance that watches so your team doesn't have to
video-surveillance.lede: Most cameras only matter after something goes wrong. KenVision turns existing CCTV into an always-on layer that detects theft, intrusion, missing PPE and fire or smoke in real time — and routes each event into a clear response SOP.

faq.q: How is this different from a standard alarm or panic button?
faq.a: Alarms react to a person pressing a button after they notice something. KenVision continuously analyzes the feed and detects theft, intrusion, PPE breaches and fire or smoke automatically, then drives a defined response SOP — before someone has to press anything.

faq.q: Does fire & smoke detection replace our sensors?
faq.a: It complements them. Camera-based visual detection can cover large or open areas and catch events that point sensors may miss, working alongside traditional fire systems.

faq.q: Will it overwhelm staff with false alerts?
faq.a: Detection is tuned to your environment and thresholds, and every alert carries the camera and zone so staff can verify quickly. The goal is fewer, more meaningful alerts tied to a clear action — not noise.

faq.q: How is footage and privacy handled?
faq.a: Processing runs on-prem or at the edge. Raw footage stays on site; alerts and logs are what move. This suits sensitive and high-value environments where data sovereignty matters.

faq.q: Does it work with our existing cameras?
faq.a: Yes. KenVision is camera-agnostic — indoor, outdoor, day or night — and layers detection onto whatever CCTV is already in place. No replacement hardware needed.

faq.q: How is KenVision different from other video-AI platforms?
faq.a: Many platforms either sell you new cloud cameras or focus on a single industry. KenVision combines four strengths at once: it runs on the existing CCTV you already own, processes video on-prem or at the edge so footage never leaves your site, is genuinely camera-agnostic across brands, and covers retail, buildings, cities and safety from one platform — not just one use case.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our cameras?
faq.a: No. KenVision is camera-agnostic and layers onto the CCTV you already have — there's no proprietary hardware and no rip-and-replace. If a camera can output a video stream, KenVision can read it.

faq.q: Where is the video processed?
faq.a: On-prem or at the edge, on your site. Only anonymized metrics and alerts move out — raw footage stays local. That makes privacy reviews and data-sovereignty compliance far simpler than cloud-only alternatives.

faq.q: How quickly can we see value?
faq.a: A first use case can typically be running in days. You then expand camera-by-camera and site-by-site on the same platform — no new procurement cycle required.

faq.q: Which industries does KenVision support?
faq.a: Retail and electronics, jewellery and high-value retail, grocery, FMCG brand activations, commercial buildings, smart cities, and worksite or perimeter safety — all from one platform with a consistent API and dashboard.

faq.q: What deployment models are available?
faq.a: KenVision supports Edge (on-device, lowest latency), On-Premise (fully local, no cloud dependency), Cloud (multi-site scale), and Hybrid (privacy-sensitive streams on-prem, aggregated reporting in cloud). The right choice depends on your privacy requirements and bandwidth — we help scope this in the first call.
